name: com.jobseveryhour/jobs
title: Jobs Every Hour
description: Jobs in every field, mostly in the US, from employers' own career pages, rechecked around the clock

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search the open tech jobs on Jobs Every Hour: every job is read from the employer's own careers page, and the lists are read again around the clock. Words are matched in the title, company, skills, place and text of each posting, best match first. Add 'remote' for remote jobs only.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. 'senior python engineer berlin' or 'solidity remote'

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: The full posting of one job: the employer's own text, place, pay, when it was posted, when it was last seen open, and the link to apply on the employer's site.

job.description: The job's slug or its page address, as search_jobs gives them
